newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil high court may vote on Band B ruling today.
newsitem.headline: Brazil high court may vote on Band B ruling today.

text.p: Brazil's highest court was scheduled to vote on Wednesday on the constitutionality of a law laying out the framework for the deregulation of the telecommunications sector, a spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman said the court would meet as of 1330 local/1630 GMT, but warned that the court's session of business was often packed and that the telecom law would not necessarily be the top priority.

The ruling, which has been put off on several occasions over the past two months, will almost certainly affect the upcoming multi-billion dollar auction of Band B cellular phone concessions. Bids for 10 concession areas are due by April 7.
